verdict.rationale: Sentry offers headless automation surfaces. An official CLI handles release and source-map management, tasks that typically run in build pipelines. A web API provides programmatic access to manage resources and export data. A Bitbucket Pipelines integration notifies Sentry of CI builds. Missing for 10: explicit docs on running the CLI in CI (e.g. auth tokens, non-interactive flags, GitHub Actions setup), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
